title: Brand in action
slide_intent: Introduce applications as examples of decisions made in context. A letter and a banner call for different uses of the same identity because people encounter them differently.
strategic_value: A section break can shift attention from isolated elements to finished communications and invite teams to adapt the system to a particular job.
demonstration: A large white title and short introduction sit in a red curved field. A section number and red symbol occupy the white band above.
practical_value: Use the following applications to identify which parts can change with the format and which parts carry the identity.

content_islands.name: Section identifier
content_islands.spec: Set the book name and Section 3 in the white header, with the red symbol at upper right.

content_islands.name: Chapter field
content_islands.spec: Carry a broad red curved field across the page. Set the white title large and place the smaller introduction below it on a common inset.
